propositions: 23 sites in test_concurrency_regression.py use _expire_sync_marker + _engine_run(..., 'list') pairs to establish fixture preconditions via incidental sync, but under CI load the best-effort read path silently fails and tests die with AssertionError: clones do not share a base

8 of the 23 sites are Kind-P (load-bearing fixture preconditions) where one clone is strictly behind the peer; these must use checked git fetch + ff-only merge (_sync_from_origin) instead of relying on swallowed failures

15 of the 23 sites are Kind-R where read-side reconvergence through the production path IS the behavior under test; converting them would delete the invariant they prove, so they must remain on _engine_run(..., 'list')

After converting 8 Kind-P sites to _sync_from_origin and grouping 15 Kind-R sites under _reconverge_by_read_sync helper, tests pass under both default env and REBAR_SYNC_PULL=off without setup assertion failures
